note: verification: 'project-notes' = recorded from the author's notes, not yet matched to a pinned source; 'extracted' = every evidence quote was found on the stated page of the sha256-pinned source and states the registry value (verification/reports/extraction.json); 'computed' = exact constant. Evidence pages are 1-based PDF page indices, not printed page labels. Quotes are short and matched after removing whitespace, brackets and dashes, which the PDF text layer drops. A range with kind 'support' states only the admissible sign or support (e.g. τ_Π > 0), not a calibrated interval; precondition checks treat its bounds as unknown. record_status/status_basis/owner/approval_date (TC-01, task 61): status follows the revision of the cited source; whether a row belongs to an Extension module awaits author review, so approval_date is null.
